checks.degree_identity: Exact BS Degree with a Major in Artificial Intelligence,2026-2027 General Announcements. Standalone degree, no inferred engineering-award equivalence.
checks.required_and_choices: Thirteen manually identified fixed records; calculus includes AP-credit alternatives, linear algebra selectsone, statistics permits three routes including whole two-course bundles. Choose three of five AI areas, one course in each. No optional pool is made fixed.
checks.elective_pools: All30 option identities reviewed individually:14 mathematics/statistics route records and16 AI-area option identities. Cross-listed aliases remain separately observable but cannot earn duplicate credit. The five areas require one course in each of three chosen areas. Graduate options have an explicit instructor-override route in university registration policy. Three explicit identity groups distinguish43 source records from39 mapped identities; no ordinary alternative or exclusion is merged.
checks.prerequisites: All43 descriptions reviewed for formal versus recommended prerequisites, concurrent enrollment, level restrictions and mutual-credit exclusions; conditions are note nodes, not universal fixed obligations. STAT315 excludes credit from STAT310/311, which turns their combination with requiredCOMP345/346 prerequisites into a substantive route-interpretation question. Capstones must be sequential within one academic year.
checks.credits_and_units: All43 individual amounts checked. Rice registration/graduation policy establishes semester credit hours, now explicit without conversion. AP calculus entries are examination credit, not taught courses; statistical bundles use3+1hours versus4 for STAT315/DSCI301. Cross-lists may not duplicate earned credit.
checks.classification: All43 manual reviews:13 fixed (3foundations,1math,5AI,2systems,1human,1domain) and30 options (3foundations,15math,8AI,1human,1domain,2mixedother). Mixed COMP631 retrieval and COMP462 robotics are explicitly other with candidate subjects; no fractional counts. Reciprocal source-reviewed cross-lists collapse four aliases, producing26 mapped option identities:3foundations,14math,5AI,1human,1domain,2mixedother. Fixed13unchanged.
checks.family_composition: No family inheritance; ECE specialization is a separate program and does not contribute requirements.
checks.degree_wide_requirements: Reread graduation, registration and transfer policies: totals, applicable catalog, resident/upper-level work, GPA/lettergrades, FWIS/placement, term-designated distribution/AD, LPAP, transfer, load, graduate override and repeat/cross-list rules mapped. Graduation and transfer residency wording remains inconsistent. Term-designated selection and individual approvals are published conditions, not missing finite pools.

blockers.issue: Graduation permits up to one summer within four full-time residency semesters; the same-year transfer page specifies four full fall/spring semesters. No source hierarchy between these GA pages resolves this wording.

This combined prerequisite-and-exclusion issue needs institutional interpretation; no automatic equivalence, waiver or extra fixed course is inferred. STAT314 additionally requires STAT310 (concurrent enrollment permitted), whereas the degree also lists STAT311+314 and the STAT310/311 descriptions exclude prior credit in the other.
